sonnet.problem: The two right words, Hebron and Jerusalem, could swap places. Nothing in the sentence or the earlier cards (which say only 'forty years') shows which city goes in which blank. 'Seven years in Jerusalem and thirty-three years in Hebron' reads just as well. Use one blank or another question type.
sonnet.rule: With two blanks, each right word fits only its own blank. If the two right words could swap places, use one blank or another question type.
